senses.gloss: (freq. אגרדמים) m. (a corrupt. of ἀγοράνομος, v. אַגְרוֹנִימוֹס) agoranomos, corresponding to the Roman ædilis, market commissioner, gauger, &c.
units: <cite ref="Avodah Zarah 58a">Ab. Zar. 58ᵃ</cite> <he>א׳ נכרי</he> (<cite ref="K00424"><he>כותי</he></cite>, Ms. V. <he>גוי א׳</he>) a gentile agoran.—
<cite ref="Bava Kamma 98a:2">B. Kam. 98ᵃ</cite> <he>א׳ טייעא</he> an Arabian agoran.—

<cite ref="Bava Batra 89a:9">B. Bath. 89ᵃ</cite> <he>מעמידין א׳ וכ׳</he> Ar. (ed. <cite ref="M01693"><he>מִין</he></cite>—plur.) an agoran. may be appointed for superintending measures, but not for fixing the prices.—Pl. <cite ref="A00343"><he>אֲגַרְדְּמִין</he></cite> B. Bath. l. c. (v. supra). [Pesik. Asser p. 96ᵃ <he>לא׳ שיצא</he> (sing.) Ar. (ed. <he>להגרונימוס</he> read <he>לא׳</he>, cmp.
<cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 729">Yalk. Ps. 729</cite>).]—<he>אֲגַרְדִּימִים</he> Sifra K’doshim ch. VIII; cmp.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Bava Batra 5:5:2">Y. B. Bath. V, 15ᵃ</cite> bot. [Oth. corrupt. v. Pesik. l. c. note.]
